name: Diary of a Madman
source:
A visual novel adapted from the short story of the same name by Guy de Maupassant, originally published in 1885. 

It follows a respected man's descent into madness and murder through journal entries discovered after his death.

[From [url=https://rippersmith-ddl.itch.io/diary-of-a-madman]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
改编自居伊·德·莫泊桑 (Guy de Maupassant) 的同名短篇小说的视觉小说，最初出版于1885年。

该剧讲述了一位受人尊敬的人通过死后发现的日记条目陷入疯狂和谋杀的故事。

[来自[url=https://rippersmith-ddl.itch.io/diary-of-a-madman]Itch.io[/url]]
